class.name: mact_controllers/MactLocalController
class.description: Modified Adaptive Computed Torque controller with the Thunder Dynamics library linked in-process: the regressors are evaluated inside the control loop, with no serialisation and no round trip.

class.name: mact_controllers/MactServerController
class.description: Modified Adaptive Computed Torque controller that carries no model: the regressors are consumed from the topics published by the Thunder Robot Server, and the controller keeps the server synchronised by publishing its state and its parameter estimate.
